overall_notes: This paper focuses on improving vision-language models using scene graphs for better compositional understanding. While it generates captions from scene graphs, the primary evaluation is on vision-language alignment tasks (Winoground, VL-Checklist, ARO, VSR) rather than traditional NLG quality assessment. The caption generation is an intermediate step in the methodology, not the main evaluation focus.
